mapper.select: SELECT id, enlist_date AS enlistDate, rank_id AS rankId FROM `user` WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND enlist_date IS NOT NULL AND (discharge_date IS NULL OR discharge_date >= CURDATE())
SELECT rank_id FROM military_rank WHERE service_months <= #{monthsSinceEnlist} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY service_months DESC LIMIT 1
